verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants work directly with a Brex account through natural language: managing expenses, looking up users, checking cards, reviewing banking transactions and tracking bills. A probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Natural-language operation runs through an external AI assistant connected to that server, and Brex's own AI-assistant marketing describes automated expense work rather than a command interface. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, detailed docs on which write actions and scopes are available via natural language, and independent hands-on corroboration.
